data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies two adversarial review requirements:
- ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Resolve enforcement.strategy config key fate
- ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Resolve record-review.sh fate explicitly (keep for observability)

## Implementation Plan

### Decision 1: record-review.sh — KEEP for observability
record-review.sh is NOT dead code. The review WORKFLOW remains active:
- Named dso:code-reviewer-* agents write reviewer-findings.json
- record-review.sh reads reviewer-findings.json and writes observability data
- The removal is only of the GATE (pre-commit-review-gate.sh checks review-status)
Action: Update record-review.sh header comment to clarify its role is observability-only, not enforcement.

### Decision 2: review-integrity-guard.sh — REMOVE (already done in Task 2)
Its only consumer was the review gate. With the gate gone, it's dead code. Task 2 handles this.

### Decision 3: enforcement.strategy config key — DEPRECATE, keep as documentation
enforcement.strategy=ci was always the target. Now that enforcement.strategy=local is gone:
Action: Update `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`:
- Mark enforcement.strategy as deprecated
- Document that only 'ci' is meaningful; 'local' value is ignored (hooks removed)
- Update the description to reflect CI-only enforcement

### Files to UPDATE:
1. `plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh`:
   - Update the top comment block to clarify: "This script records review results for observability. It no longer serves a gate-enforcement function — the review gate (pre-commit-review-gate.sh) has been removed. This script produces review audit data consumed by CI and reporting tools."

2. `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`:
   - Find the enforcement.strategy section
   - Add deprecation notice: enforcement.strategy=local is no longer supported (hooks removed); enforcement.strategy=ci is the only operative value
   - Update the description to not imply that local gates exist

3. Check `plugins/dso/scripts/health-check.sh` for review-status scanning (adversarial review flagged health-check.sh lines 103-104):
   - Update health-check.sh to remove review-status scan or mark it as informational-only

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] record-review.sh header comment clarifies observability-only role (not enforcement)
  Verify: grep -q 'observability' plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md marks enforcement.strategy=local as removed/deprecated
  Verify: grep -q 'deprecated\|no longer supported\|removed' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] health-check.sh does not hard-require review-status as a health gate
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Resolve record-review.sh fate and document enforcement.strategy deprecation
